To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
new treatment approaches combining phytoextracts and standard chemotherapy hamper the viability and stemness properties of colorectal cancer stem cells.
new treatment approaches, comprising polymethoxyﬂavones and prenﬂavonoids, hamper the survival and stemness features of colorectal cancer stem cells as well as synergize with standard chemotherapy.
Nobiletin and xanthohumol sensitize CR CSCs to FOX chemotherapy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of natural compounds with anti cancer properties.
the use of natural compounds in combination with chemotherapy to target CR CSCs.
the development of novel therapeutic strategies for the treatment of CRC patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Nobiletin and xanthohumol in combination with 5 fluororacil and oxalipaltin, are effective in reducing the viability of colorectal cancer stem cells and synergizing with standard chemotherapy.
our results show that Citrus sinensis extract and Humulus lupulos extract can be used as a new natural remedy to aid chemotherapy in the treatment of colorectal cancer.
our study demonstrates that Nobiletin and/or Xanthohumoli are efficacious anti cancer drugs in the treatment of metastatic CRC patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Nobiletin and xanthohumol are efficacious anti cancer agents that sensitize colorectal cancer stem cells to standard chemotherapy.

we show how natural compounds extracted from Citrus and Humulus plants, singularly and combined with chemotherapy, are capable to target the CR CSC population, thus improving the efficacy of current therapies.
the use of phytoextracts, such as Nobiletin and/or Xanthohumoli, in conjunction with FOX, could be beneficial to patients suffering from metastatic CRC refractory to standard therapy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Nobiletin and xanthohumol can be used in combination with chemotherapy in order to target CR CSCs and hamper the outgrowth of metastatic cancer cells.
the use of natural biofunctional extracts can sensitize CR CSCs to standard chemotherapy, thus improving the outcome of cancer treatment.

the combination of Nobiletin and FOX, as well as Xanthohumulone and FOX, can be considered a promising therapeutic strategy to treat patients refractory to FOX based chemotherapy and with high risk of metastasis.
